name: Dark Riders
summary: In Duskwood, the Dark Riders hunt magical relics and terrorize the land. Hooded and merciless, they strike from hiding and leave slaughter behind.

sections.title: Hunters in the Dark
sections.body: Little is known of the Dark Riders' beginnings. Witnesses speak of hooded horsemen with harsh, shrill voices. One was seen using a small gem to receive orders from a master it called only its “Lord.” Across the kingdom, they hunt objects of magical power. Anyone who stands between them and their prize is cut down.

sections.title: Slaughter at the Farmstead
sections.body: The Dark Riders came to Duskwood after strange tremors began radiating from the Scythe of Elune, warping space. The miner Jitters had found the ancient staff inside Roland's Doom, then promptly lost it. The horsemen followed its magical trace to nearby Yorgen Farmstead and demanded the artifact from Sven Yorgen's family. The terrified settlers had no answers. The Riders butchered Sven's wife and children, driving Sven into vengeful madness.

sections.title: Shadows over Duskwood
sections.body: Whispers in Duskwood link the Dark Riders' sinister hunts to the rogue necromancer Morbent Fel. No one knows what binds them, or who the “Lord” they answer to may be.

aliases: who are the riders in duskwood
faq.answer: The Dark Riders are hooded horsemen who hunt objects of magical power. They slaughter anyone who stands in their way, while their origins and the identity of their master remain a mystery.

faq.q: What did they do to Sven Yorgen's family?
aliases: why did riders kill svens family
faq.answer: The Dark Riders were hunting the Scythe of Elune, unearthed nearby. Sven Yorgen's wife and children knew nothing of the artifact, so the Riders murdered them without mercy.

faq.q: Why are the Dark Riders in Duskwood?
aliases: why are dark riders in duskwood
faq.answer: The Dark Riders came to Duskwood, drawn by temporal and magical disturbances from the Scythe of Elune. The ancient artifact had been unearthed in Roland's Doom.

aliases: what are dark riders made of
faq.answer: No one knows whether the Dark Riders are undead. They speak in harsh, shrill voices and strike from hiding, but what lies beneath their hooded cloaks remains a mystery.

faq.q: Are they working with Morbent Fel?
faq.answer: The Night Watch has noted suspicious dealings between the Dark Riders and the necromancer Morbent Fel in Duskwood. The exact terms of their alliance remain unknown.

angles.text: The Dark Riders' ruthless hunt for the Scythe of Elune threatens the balance. The weapon's feral energies can wreak havoc across Duskwood.
The Dark Riders strike just beyond Stormwind's borders and slaughter innocent homesteaders like Sven Yorgen's family. The kingdom's frontier has slipped far from its grasp.
Relentless hunters of magical relics, the Dark Riders show how much blood the pursuit of arcane power can cost.
